name: Manas Resources Limited
summary: Manas Resources Limited engages in the acquisition, exploration, evaluation, and development of gold properties in Australia. Its principal properties are the Mbengué gold project that covers an area of 647 square kilometers; the Eburnea gold project; and the Tortiya gold project covering an area of 780 square kilometers located in Côte D'Ivoire. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mount Hawthorn, Australia.
